title: Prove exact unitary Clifford correction rank (no κ)
body:
## Summary

For q=2^s independent rank-one Clifford lanes, the exact correction rank with a unitary reciprocal encoder and one phased width-(s+1) child is `q-2^floor(s/2)` after phase/direction optimization. Sixteen lanes require and attain rank twelve. An explicit attaining real orthogonal encoder has entries 0 or +/-1/4.

```text
T = I_q tensor C
E* E = I
B = E* (i^u C_(s+1)^eta) E
F B = T
min rank(F-I) = m_-1 + m_-i
```

Claim type: scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. The Hermitian supporting functional forces the equality kernel to avoid both unwanted eigenspaces; orthogonal spectral matching attains the lower bound. The universal quantifiers rest on PROOF.md.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ywz65 / [PR2516](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2516) for the sharp unrestricted correction and physical-boundary question, Arham Tahir / [PR1920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1920) for the reciprocal contract, and the retained Greer Guthrie, Ross Richardson, ToikY, Douglas Colkitt, Jose Manuel, Cinna Davis, Josie Elliston and native/kernel lineage. The cited unrestricted rank-six optimum has a different encoder domain and is not replayed as this deliverable. Classical spectral and Walsh methods retain their credit.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19362348). The changed card scope and exact canonical-main/source pins are in TASK.json and SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

- Before this result, PR2516's exact correction theorem allows arbitrary invertible encoders. The new theorem settles the norm-preserving subclass, including its all-size formula and complete sixteen-lane endpoint.
- `PASS_UNITARY_CLIFFORD_CORRECTION`: 520 spectral cases, 40 full operators, 10,912 complete native entries against a separate kernel, 322,768 small spectral permutations, 31 rational mixed encoders, seven rejected domains/mutations and four semantic control groups.
- Exact block-determinant ranks agree with independent elimination lower bounds over F5 and F13. No finite permutation list is presented as an enumeration of arbitrary unitaries.
- Both warning-strict direct modes passed locally on CPython 3.12.15, each timed at 0.22 seconds. Both registered commands passed. Normal/optimized generated receipts are identical and bind all six package files.
- Read-only Git-free replay with an empty executable search path passed. Committed-byte/source-history checks passed for all six files and canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Selected baseline bindings passed as metadata orientation only.

## Limitations

Algebraic correction rank is not a native ADD count or recursive tariff. Encoding, correction realization, coefficient reads, routing, storage, restoration, precision, stock, compiler and the complete caller bill remain unpriced. The inherited joined-volume upper expression already loses with free adapters; this theorem does not reopen that physical route. Arbitrary invertible encoding, independent input/output maps, multiple children and promised clean subspaces remain outside the result.

No new kappa, supplier admission, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. All five framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected cold replay, predecessor scientific replay, native/compiler build, Lean or Docker run was performed.

## Open next questions

- Determine the least encoder condition number permitting the cited sixteen-lane rank-six optimum. Start with one unwanted two-eigenvalue block and its singular values; a conditioned-similarity lower bound remains missing.
- Specify a real consumer and a favorable changed volume tariff, then price the complete orthogonal rank-twelve boundary. Physical realization and a complete paid invoice remain missing.

Neither follow-up is reserved.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this fixed unitary-encoder correction optimum was found in the precommit live targeted searches. Nearby open work has different claims:

- PR2329 changes production Clifford zero-state evaluation and provenance. This package has no executable dependency on that evaluator and does not measure its runtime.
- PR872 proves a packed Clifford representation bridge for a historical child. It does not optimize this reciprocal encoding or correction rank.
- PR581 formalizes one historical canonical child identity. It does not cover the one-child lane replacement theorem here.
- PR6402 concerns square-zero tensor error and precision. This result is exact operator rank without a rounding-error claim.
- PR6448 adds a row-sparse Gaussian evaluator for the complete PR800 replay. Its implementation and work-count claims concern a different consumer; no correction-rank optimum is asserted there.

The completion refresh inspected all fourteen other open account PRs created since the CLAIM. None studies this fixed unitary-encoder optimum or reports a conflicting value for its instance. No extra computations audited another contribution.

No extra computations were run to audit these contributions or compare unrelated numbers. The main README/proof and merged/general-form searches found no existing copy of this theorem. Sparse historical notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.
